entities.summary: Akira Nishimura was a heads of state & government in Osaka (1953-09-08, Osaka – 2023-09-07) who made significant contributions during the Contemporary era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced national policy and international relations.
